g.title: nvfp4_coldstart
g.text: nvidia/Qwen3-8B-NVFP4 . RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell (24 GB GDDR7) . vLLM v0.22.1
phase order from vLLM's log; measured times for groups of phases (3 launches, 2026-07)

g.title: P4
g.text: driver handshake, primary ctx, cuBLAS handles

g.title: P6
g.text: NVFP4 tensors + FP8 scales + two BF16 vocabulary matrices
weights 1.5-1.6 s for 5.98 GiB: not PCIe-bound

g.title: P7
g.text: cutlass NVFP4 GEMM operands, per-block scales (+ MTP head if on)

g.title: P8
g.text: torch.compile of the model graph (15 s), FlashInfer / NVFP4 kernel JIT,

g.title: P9
g.text: --gpu-memory-utilization x device memory minus profiled use

g.title: P10
g.text: 10. NVFP4 GEMM autotune + CUDA graph capture
batch sizes up to --max-num-seqs (32): 11 piecewise up to 64, 7 full up to 32
(capture 1 s, 0.16 GiB; with MTP, K+1 tokens per sequence per step)

g.title: P11
g.text: router polls every 2 s, then proxies the queued request (2 s)
